answer: The cheapest real defence: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because wander only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, nebula is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any quartz approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
